paragraphs.source_en: Had the person before him been anyone but his wife, Katsuyori would surely have shouted a rebuke long ago and stormed away. Whom should he send to Odawara, and what should that person say? Though his thoughts were in utter turmoil, Katsuyori could not scold his beloved wife. This was due not only to the difference in their ages, but also to her eternally youthful purity, which enveloped even a warrior like Katsuyori in the warmth of spring.

paragraphs.source_en: Since the disastrous defeat at Nagashino, Katsuyori had completely transformed the tactics handed down through generations of the Takeda house. Where cavalry had traditionally formed the main force, he now made infantry armed with bows and arquebuses the core of his army. He also instituted new military regulations: every arquebus was to be supplied with three hundred rounds, and every shot was required to strike its target.

paragraphs.source_zh: 自从长筱惨败之后，胜赖也彻底改变了武田家祖传的战术。历来以骑兵为主，现在改为持弓箭、火枪的步兵为主力，而且制订了新的军规，一支火枪必须准备三百发子弹，并且要求每发必中。

paragraphs.source_en: Ever since the defeat at Nagashino, Katsuyori had spared no effort in seeking out men of talent, and the ranks depleted by his losses were now almost entirely restored. His present strength could be said to rival what it had once been—was he still no match for Ieyasu?
